name: Webform Counter
description: Provides Submissions Counter feature for webforms.
project_description: Webform Counter adds a live submissions counter to any Webform. After filling in the module's per-webform third-party settings (an optional offline base count, an optional target count, and singular/plural count text), you place a token in webform markup or any token-aware text: [site:webform-counter:MACHINE_NAME] renders the count as text, and [site:webform-counter-progress:MACHINE_NAME] renders a progress bar plus text. The rendered token is a placeholder that a small AJAX behavior replaces with the real count on page load, so the counter is not cached with the page. Typical use is social proof on campaign or petition forms ("123 people already signed") and progress toward a target.
